founders.name: Leo Li
founders.bio: Founder at Preload (YC F26). PhD student in Computational Neuroscience at Caltech. Previously Neuroengineer at Neuralink and software engineer at Amazon. BASc in Engineering Science (Robotics) from University of Toronto.

founders.name: Surya Pandiaraju
founders.bio: Founder at Preload (YC F26). PhD candidate at Johns Hopkins BME, Waterloo BME grad Previously worked at - Sonera Magnetics - iota Biosciences - NeuroPace - Paradromics

founders.name: Runming (Tony) Wang
founders.bio: Founder at Preload (YC F26). Biomedical Engineering PhD candidate at Johns Hopkins School of Medicine. Developed the first brain application of the Freeform Stimulator platform for focal cortical modulation. Performs animal neurosurgeries and fabricates neural recording and stimulation hardware. Previously conducted research at Emory/Georgia Tech on motor-unit coordination using EMG and motion tracking. BS in Neuroscience from Emory.

name: Lux Foods
description: Crops engineered for premium fruit, grown without sunlight.

founders.name: Andre Yeung
founders.bio: CEO & co-founder at Lux Foods. Stanford BioE/Computer Science (AI) B.S./B.S.. First lab student in Dr. Robert Jinkerson's lab at UC Riverside, leading project on endosymbiotic gene transfer in algae. Previously student researcher at Brophy Lab working on synthetic genetic circuits in plants. Founded Fruit for Homeless nonprofit, leading 25 students to rescue and distribute 300,000 pounds of fresh fruit to underserved LA communities. Regeneron STS Semi-finalist, iGEM silver medalist.

founders.name: Robert Jinkerson
founders.bio: Co-founder & CSO at Lux Foods. Professor of Chemical Engineering at UC Riverside since 2017, engineering crops for controlled environments and space. Led the UCR team that won NASA's Deep Space Food Challenge and flew cherry tomatoes to the ISS. NSF CAREER Award, FFAR New Innovator Award. Showed plants can grow on acetate without sunlight (Nature Food 2022). Previously postdoc at Stanford; PhD, Colorado School of Mines.

name: Asim
description: Enable robots to operate safely in the real world.

founders.name: Douglas Tilley
founders.bio: Founder at Asim. PhD candidate in AI with Robotics at the University of Bath. Previously ML researcher at National Institute of Informatics (Tokyo) and Tianjin University. 3x Doctoral Recognition Award Winner. Researcher on Safe Human Robot interaction with multiple papers in Hierarchical Machine Learning, Robot Learning and Out-of-Distribution detection.

founders.name: Raphaël Lafargue
founders.bio: Co-founder at Asim. ex-Senior Research Scientist @ Sony / PhD in AI @ IMT Atlantique/University of Adelaide / M.Sc. Physics @ ENS Paris-Saclay.

founders.name: Tristan Lecourtois
founders.bio: Founder at Asim (YC F26). Ex NASA JPL, MS from ENS Paris-Saclay.

founders.name: Maëlic Neau
founders.bio: Founder at Asim (YC F26). Joint PhD in Computer Science and Robotics from Flinders University and ENIB. Two times world champion of the RoboCup@Home international competition. Published at ICCV, oral presentation at BMVC 2025. Previously WASP Postdoctoral Fellow at Umea University.

founders.name: Maxim Williams
founders.bio: Founder of Axonnic. Oxford MBiol Biology and author of research on HD-sEMG. Previously built internal tools at Skyscanner and early employee at Voxblock, working across PCB development, supply chain and its Series A fundraise.

founders.name: Samarth Malhotra

Previously founded and scaled Parts World USA from sub-$100k to $3M revenue in 4 years by building global supply chains across China, India, Vietnam, Malaysia & USA. Founded Jumps Tronic (hardware manufacturing). Worked on ML at Facebook and HP. BS in Computer Science from Carnegie Mellon; Dropped out of ETH Zürich.

founders.name: Kristof Floch
founders.bio: Founder/CTO at Theseus Robotics, developing AI for humanoids that restock shelves and pick grocery orders. Previously VP of Technology at ETH Robotics Club, leading 120 robotics students across six teams. Researched high-performance learning-based control at ETH Zürich and SZTAKI. First-author publications in IEEE TCST and at ECC. ETH Zürich Excellence Scholar in Robotics, Systems and Control.

founders.name: Ádám Weinhardt-Kovács
founders.bio: Founder/CPO at Theseus Robotics. Previously robotics engineer at Flink Robotics, where he led deployment of a pick-and-place system at live sorting centers achieving 600 picks/hour matching human performance. Designed full robotic work-cells and built custom pneumatic grippers. Published ML research on vehicle dynamics at IFAC SYSID 2024. MA in Robotics from ETH Zürich.

founders.name: Tiantian Li
founders.bio: Founder/CTO at Nines (YC F26). Previously at Meta, Xerox PARC. Cornell CS

founders.name: Kieran White
founders.bio: Co-Founder & CEO at Mantle, the pit crew for machines and robots. Previously founded Curo (YC F24), the world's largest private EV charging network. Curo scaled to 5,000 stations with Uber, Zoox and Google before acquisition by Inspiration Mobility Group ($415M raised). Before Curo I joined Tesla at 18 as the youngest employee.

founders.name: Graham Smith
founders.bio: Co-Founder & CTO at Mantle, the pit crew for machines and robots. Previously founded Babylon, the world’s largest fleet of autonomous vertical farms. Babylon raised $22M and deployed 400 farms with Compass, LinkedIn and American Airlines. Before Babylon I scaled an electronics repair business I started at 14.

description: Robotics workforce for hotels

founders.name: Archer Lin
founders.bio: Founder/CEO at Vibe Robotics. Previously ML Engineer at NVIDIA, PM at Tesla.

founders.name: Katherine Ma
founders.bio: Co-Founder & CPO at Vibe Robotics. Previously Technical Program Management at Tesla and AI Research at KPMG.

name: Avision
description: Developer of an unmanned aerial navigation platform designed to control the communication and navigation of robots and drones. The company's platform is comprised of air traffic control software, drone built-in hardware components, and an integration API that automatically regulates traffic for all UAVs connected to it, enabling aerial industries to manage any number of drones with business applications ranging from entertainment to enterprise logistics.

name: Connected Robotics
description: Developer of cooking robots designed to solve the shortage of labor faced by the Japanese restaurant industry. The company uses artificial intelligence image processing and robot control technologies to bring back happiness to workers by using deep learning to make intelligent robots in the kitchen, enabling clients in restaurants, shopping malls, stations, service areas, amusement centers, and large-scale events to provide fun and healthy meals to consumers and contribute to creating a better society.

name: GITAI
description: Operator of a space robotics startup intended to conduct tasks in all realms of space development. The company's remote-controlled robots feature low-latency communication and NAT traversal system as well as provide an alternative to human astronauts for long-time work in low earth orbit space stations, enabling space development organizations to reduce the burden on astronauts, shorten the time it takes to perform work in space and reduce costs.

name: Imajin
description: Operator of a manufacturing marketplace intended to build a manufacturing ecosystem in Indonesia. The company specializes in making molds, dies, and parts for CNC machine rental by connecting designers, machine facilities, 3D Printing, and manufacturer expert, enabling founders to create their own products from one single piece to mass production.

name: INDEX Robotics
description: Developer of a humanoid platform and a learning-based automation solution to replace repetitive, dexterous manual work in manufacturing. The company differentiates through in-house actuators and motor drivers, a high-DoF hand with wrist and head vision, and controls focus on torque/positioning precision that aims to outperform conventional cobots in fine, high-variance work.

name: Koska
description: Developer of an accounting platform designed to fully visualize invisible costs. The company's platform has a unique ability to visualize the site required for production control and to offer real-time cost accounting calculations, enabling the manufacturing industry to monitor operations as well as the cost of production of their fixed assets which leads to the identification and improvement of profitability.

name: Mogassam
description: Manufacturer of automatic digital light processing (DLP) 3D printers designed to bring convenient reliable 3D printing for creative dentists. The company designs manufacture and market DLP 3D printers that help to self-customize and produce their 3D products with affordable price and quality and also offers automated dental CAM software, enabling dentists to demolish all barriers and get a seamless dental 3D printing experience.

name: Movel AI
description: Operator of a robotic deployment software solution company intended to simplify the deployment and usage of robots for both hardware companies and end users. The company's platform helps to deploy robots better in a sleek, accurate, and user-friendly manner with advanced deployment solutions to cut down on deployment time and cost, thereby enabling users to get robots up and running quickly, efficiently, and with minimal training.

name: Mycotech
description: Producer of mycelium-based composites intended to deliver sustainable materials from renewable resources. The company's composites are affordable, environment-friendly, and recyclable materials from agricultural waste, bound together with mushroom mycelia to form custom shapes such as panels, tiles, cabinetry, and interiors, enabling customers to get durable and lightweight products made from strong and organic fibers.

name: Simplex
description: Manufacturer of computer numerical control machines designed to provide automated cutting and engraving of wooden and marble works. The company's machines are of different features to satisfy the customer's needs, which can reduce waste, frequency of errors, and the time the finished product takes to get to market, enabling clients to save time and increase productivity of their business.
